_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::structural_mechanics#11 — DENS is a REQUIRED key of MAT_Struct_StVenantKirchhoff in every analysis type, Statics included, and the fixture checks BOTH halves of the distinction the entry draws. Four arms of one 3D HEX8 deck, run 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C. The value really is irrelevant under Statics: DENS 1.0 and DENS 1000000.0 both exit 0 and both pass the SAME RESULT DESCRIPTION pinned at 1e-12 (RESULT_FAILURES=0 for both), six orders of magnitude apart. The key is mandatory all the same: omitting it exits 1 under DYNAMICTYPE Statics AND under OneStepTheta, with "Failed to match specification in section 'MATERIALS'" from global_data/4C_global_data_read.cpp line 1377 and "Expected parameter 'DENS'" from core/io/4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp line 633. The rejection is at parse, before anything is built: STATICS_NO_DENS_REACHED_FILL_COMPLETE=0 and OST_NO_DENS_REACHED_FILL_COMPLETE=0 against 2 for the working deck, with OST_NO_DENS_MISSING_KEY_REPORTS=1. So the common advice that density 'is only needed for dynamics' describes whether the number matters, never whether the line may be left out.
expect_in_output: Failed to match specification in section 'MATERIALS'

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the Statics arm: put DENS back. The parse failure disappears and EXIT_STATICS_NO_DENS becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the OneStepTheta arm too. EXIT_OST_NO_DENS becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
